Package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.application.chat

Interface StartConversationUseCase

All Known Implementing Classes:
StartConversationService
public interface StartConversationUseCase
Use case for POST /conversations (US-10-005).

Starts a brand-new, empty conversation between the caller and one of their own agents. The owner check is REQ-AGT-006 / REQ-CHAT-001:

  • a ConversationOwner.UserOwner may only chat with an agent they own (cross-owner read surfaces as 404, not 403 — design §8.6 existence-hiding);
  • a ConversationOwner.SystemOwner always 404s in v1 because no agent is SYSTEM-owned; the agents.owner_id schema column still references users(id) only. A future EPIC may relax this if a SYSTEM-owned-agents capability lands.

The fresh conversation has title=null and messageCount=0; the first non-empty user message (EPIC-11's SendMessageService) auto-derives the title.
